# Safe & Responsible AI Use at Work — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — 10 scenarios: allowed or not?

*Module 1: Your AI policy in practice · about 12 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_allowed_or_not.py`): Replace POLICY with your organisation's approved tools and data classes. Which verdicts change? Add two scenarios from your own week.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — Spot the attack

*Module 2: Threats · about 12 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_spot_the_attack.py`): In pairs: write one message that tries to trick an assistant. Add it to the list in labkit/guard.py ATTACKS and see if it is caught. Then design the control that would catch it.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — Report a mock incident

*Module 3: Incidents and escalation · about 12 minutes*

**With demo 3** (`python demos/03_incident_triage.py`): Each table writes one realistic 'something went wrong with AI' sentence, runs it, and fills the report. Did the severity feel right? Change a rule if not.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
